verdict.rationale: Docs show console/Terraform/API creation of CKS clusters and Node Pools with GPU nodes, on-demand and Spot capacity, kubeconfig generation to immediately run kubectl/code against the cluster (coreweave-docs-1,4,7,20,26). However, provisioning is Kubernetes-cluster-centric rather than a simple single-instance API, and there is no first-party or independent evidence confirming actual end-to-end time-to-running-code is 'minutes'. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on timing benchmarks, a simpler single-GPU-instance provisioning path distinct from full cluster/node-pool setup.
